6"><h1>ustwo Accessibility Help</h1></div><div class="Grid-module--col--39b2c textMarginTop" style="grid-column:2 / span 8"><h2>This website has been designed to work for everyone.</h2>
<p>Our website has been tested internally against WCAG Level 2.2 AA.</p>
<p>You should be able to operate it with the input device of your choice (keyboard, mouse, touchpad, game controller, brain/computer interface, etc), and understand it using whatever output device you prefer (screen, braille display, screen reader, etc)</p>
<p>You should also be able to:</p>
<ul>
<li>Change colours, contrast levels and fonts using browser or device settings</li>
<li>Zoom in up to 400% without the text spilling off the screen</li>
<li>Reduce motion support and better control video content</li>
</ul>
<p>If you cannot – then we have let you down, and we are sorry. We love talking to our users. We would love to talk to you – and make it up to you!</p>
<p>Please consider contacting us to report the issue at <a href="mailto:info@ustwo.com">info@ustwo.com</a>.</p>
<br/>
<p>There are a few known improvements in the pipeline:</p>
<ul>
<li>Offset outlines for buttons</li>
<li>Improvements to reduced motion including handling fade-in text</li>
<li>Image transitions for our product packages</li>
<li>Tabbing behaviour when navigating between links</li>
</ul>
<br/>
<h2>ustwo's Accessibility principles</h2>
<p>We achieved this by following the ustwo Accessibility principles:</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Level-up your gear</strong>
Just use the tools. There is a wealth of accessibility testing tools (contrast checkers, checklists, simulators). Use them to ensure your work meets basic accessibility standards.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Enjoy the patterns</strong>
An accessible design pattern is a repeatable solution that solves a common accessibility problem. We are a team of highly original and unique creative minds – but we're not the first to need form validation, or a tooltip.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Think beyond touch</strong>
Most users are happy with touchscreens and trackpads. But it is essential we think beyond mice and touch. Using our keyboards allows us to determine if our work is perceivable, operable, understandable, and robust.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Close your eyes</strong>
If it's usable with a keyboard, there’s a good chance it’ll work nicely with a screenreader. But we won’t know this unless we try it ourselves. Everyone on the project should learn how to use at least one screen reader – and use it!</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Party party (test) party!</strong>
Testing the application for accessibility is not just the tester's responsibility. We get our teams together and huddle around the work. If our diverse teams can use it on all the phones, in all the browsers, and with all the input and output devices… then what we've created is truly usable</p>
</li>
</ol></div></div></div></header></article></main><footer class="Footer-module--footer--f407a"><section class="Section-module--section--d8c31"><div class="Section-module--inner--76c37 undefined"><div https://ustwo.com/accessibility-help/.visible_text: Accessibility Help | ustwo Skip to content Services Work AI Insights Our story Contact us ustwo Accessibility Help This website has been designed to work for everyone. Our website has been tested internally against WCAG Level 2.2 AA. You should be able to operate it with the input device of your choice (keyboard, mouse, touchpad, game controller, brain/computer interface, etc), and understand it using whatever output device you prefer (screen, braille display, screen reader, etc) You should also be able to: Change colours, contrast levels and fonts using browser or device settings Zoom in up to 400% without the text spilling off the screen Reduce motion support and better control video content If you cannot – then we have let you down, and we are sorry. We love talking to our users. We would love to talk to you – and make it up to you! Please consider contacting us to report the issue at info@ustwo.com . There are a few known improvements in the pipeline: Offset outlines for buttons Improvements to reduced motion including handling fade-in text Image transitions for our product packages Tabbing behaviour when navigating between links ustwo's Accessibility principles We achieved this by following the ustwo Accessibility principles: Level-up your gear Just use the tools. There is a wealth of accessibility testing tools (contrast checkers, checklists, simulators). Use them to ensure your work meets basic accessibility standards. Enjoy the patterns An accessible design pattern is a repeatable solution that solves a common accessibility problem. We are a team of highly original and unique creative minds – but we're not the first to need form validation, or a tooltip. Think beyond touch Most users are happy with touchscreens and trackpads. But it is essential we think beyond mice and touch. Using our keyboards allows us to determine if our work is perceivable, operable, understandable, and robust. Close your eyes If it's usable with a keyboard, there’s a good chance it’ll work nicely with a screenreader. But we won’t know this unless we try it ourselves. Everyone on the project should learn how to use at least one screen reader – and use it! Party party (test) party! Testing the application for accessibility is not just the tester's responsibility. We get our teams together and huddle around the work. If our diverse teams can use it on all the phones, in all the browsers, and with all the input and output devices… then what we've created is truly usable Services Work AI Insights Our story Employee owned B Corp Join us Contact us Follow us Sign up to our newsletter This website is hosted on green servers located in regions with renewable energy generation. Read what we did We are dedicated to making our output accessible to all users. Cookie Policy | Website Terms of Use Our Policies | Legal Copyright © ustwo Ltd 2026 . All rights reserved. We partner with you at any stage to shape, build, or scale ideas. Our process brings together strategy, design, and engineering in a way that fits your goals and team. Typical activities Market research Stakeholder interviews Collaborative co-creation In-depth research Concept & prototype testing Tech considerations Outcomes Synthesized success criteria Vision artifacts Business design thinking Engagement length From 8 weeks ustwo's determination and ability to get a deep understanding of our customers made them an invaluable voice in board meetings, helping us make the right decisions for the customers and therefore for the business. Jasmine Skee Director of Propositions at Three Shape Pilot new services and brands through design and development We refine solutions through user research with a make, test, learn approach, to gain insight on your digital product. This builds value where it counts, leading to early-stage buy-in where everyone is ready to launch and go to market. Our team is built around your needs, that’s used to executing fast and with confidence. Typical activities Iterative production design and build Continuous research Beta testing Business readiness for launch Outcomes Growth and loyalty NPS and customer experience scores Operational efficiency Engagement length 6 weeks to 1+ years We truly wouldn’t have reached this milestone without the hard work from the ustwo team. These experiences are openly embraced across work and life — creating a sense of optimism, not dread, for the future. Business Efficiency It's the business that gets new features to market in half the time with AI-boosted product teams. Social Impact It's a person with breast cancer using AI for the first time to feel more empowered through their recovery. Product Innovation It’s someone with severe neurological impairment being able to experience more independence through daily tasks AI Operating Systems It's a Gen Zer hanging out with friends whilst an AI assistant does their admin tasks for them Intelligence meets imagination Intelligence meets imagination Above all, we believe that AI is nothing without creativity. We combine the two to create products that make a real difference for you and your customers. Ready to meet your users with AI solutions? Get started or discover ways to work together to get ahead: 1 day Spark A workshop to generate new thinking and prioritise your AI uses cases - so you can move forward with speed. Let's chat 2-3 weeks Inspire Catalysing adoption of AI tooling in your organisation - so you can maximise your investment. Let's chat 4+ weeks Mine Mining your existing data for new experience opportunities - so you can get ready to unlock hidden value. Let's chat Our Principles to help organisations get ahead Our Principles to help organisations get ahead What's next is coming faster than ever. We apply 4 principles to help organisations lead, not follow: Adaptive We use AI to make experiences that are empathetic, contextually aware and responsive to users Explainable We build understanding of AI through transparency - to boost adoption of these new experiences Focused We keep scope tight to de-risk AI products and build quickly Responsible We put proactive safeguards in place to ensure AI works for the many, not just the few Making it tangible Making it tangible All of our work with AI is backed up with technical capability that extends across the full spectrum of AI development: Data mining / AI readiness, Testing and guardrail development / Model selection / Proof of concept development / AI user interface and experience design / Hardware companion apps / Multi-modal AI development / Retrieval augmented generation (RAG) and Knowledge base development / AI search and summarization workflows / On-device and local model product development / Internal co-pilot and agentic workflow design AI Case Studies Inflection AI View case study Designing and scaling emotionally intelligent AI interfaces Product Design, Website, iOS App Sproutiful View case study Making behavioural change simple, from zero to working product in 8 weeks Digital Coaching, Emotive Design, Rapid iOS build HSBC / Klir View case study Delivering full-stack, end to end AI-powered financial insights Product Design, Beta Brand, iOS & Android App A Conversation with Mustafa Suleyman , CEO of Microsoft AI Clips of the talk including shots of the audience and close ups of the speakers.
